artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape scene with text titles and an illustration of a figure carrying a basket. The drawing depicts a landscape view with rolling hills and trees in simple, expressive lines. In the foreground, there is a stylized figure of a person in a hooded cloak carrying a rounded basket. The drawing includes handwritten text in French, listing what appears to be titles or captions. The prominent text includes phrases like “1 - La Marchande de Chiffons” and other numbered titles. The style reflects an influence of the late 19th-century art movement, characterized by decorative qualities and simplicity. The drawing is attributed to Paul Sérusier, with his name appearing at the bottom, embracing elements of symbolism and abstraction.

artworks.title: The Pursuit
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image features a black-and-white illustration on a beige background with handwritten French text. At the top is a black-framed rectangular artwork depicting five men in dark clothing, portrayed facing forward with one man reaching out towards another. Below the illustration, there is a list on the left titled "Le bon Marché" with three items: "des petites filles," "la charge," and "baigneuses (bois)" signed by "F. VALLOTTON." Underneath, larger handwriting displays "Pierre Bonnard" followed by "I Tête de femme" and "II La rue D'Agnry." The background is plain, emphasizing the illustration and text.

artworks.title: A Boy in Florentine Costume
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person in a dynamic crouched position. The individual is leaning forward with one leg bent, one arm extended back, holding a baton-like object in each hand. The person's facial features are in profile, with short curly hair partially covered by headwear. They are dressed in a form-fitting outfit with distinct buttons. There are no visible accessories or additional objects. The background is a plain, light-colored textured surface.

artworks.title: Landscape with Gnarled Trees and Fisherman
artworks.artist: Circle of Jacques de Gheyn (possibly Jacques de Gheyn III)
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with two figures near a tree on the left and a large tree on the right. In the background, there is a body of water with a boat and various buildings near mountains. The horizon is high, showing a sky with clouds and birds. The art style is pen and ink with energetic cross-hatching, using shades of brown and gray.

artworks.title: Forest Interior
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over graphite with white heightening on laid paper

artworks.title: Historical Costumes
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexandra Baer and Jason Iahn
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of various full-body figures drawn with minimalistic lines. The figures are standing and include both men and women. The facial features are simple and not detailed, with only some outlines hinting at eyes, noses, or mouths. Various hairstyles are shown, with some women having their hair styled in buns or veils, while men are wearing hats. The clothing appears to be historical or formal, with men in coats, breeches, and wide-brimmed hats, and women in long, flowing dresses or cloaks, some with head coverings. One figure is depicted on horseback, showing more dynamic movement. The background is a plain sheet of paper with no additional details or context provided, aside from some lines indicating ground or shadow under the figures.

artworks.title: Dante Flees the Wild Beasts and Meets Virgil
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper, mounted on nineteenth-century album sheet
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 25.7 x 37.8 cm (10 1/8 x 14 7/8 in.)
overall (album sheet): 35.2 x 50 cm (13 7/8 x 19 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures interacting in a natural setting with trees. On the right, a lion, a canine, and other animals are depicted in motion. The pencil strokes are loose and energetic, conveying movement and emotion. The composition suggests a dynamic and dramatic scene from literature or mythology.

artworks.title: Gardens of the Villa Mattei
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view. The terrain is rugged with a mix of natural and man-made features. A hill occupies the center of the composition with trees, bushes, and architectural elements. There are walls and a small building with a triangular pediment. The vegetation and architecture are detailed with sepia-toned ink, creating a classic quality. The ground has grass and water patterns for depth. The color palette is muted and harmonious, emphasizing nature and man-made elements.

artworks.title: Male Nude Posing for Figures in the "Frise de la Guerre"
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a pencil drawing of a male figure in multiple poses on textured paper. On the left, the man is seated, leaning slightly forward with his right hand on his left knee. His head is turned to the side, revealing detailed muscular arms and back. His hair is swept back, and facial features are not fully drawn. On the right, the man is shown from a different angle, focusing on his upper body. His face in profile shows closed eyes and full lips. His right arm is raised, bent at the elbow as he holds his head, emphasizing arm and chest musculature. The figure is unclothed, and the background is plain, highlighting the male anatomy.

artworks.title: A Peasant Girl in a Straw Hat
artworks.medium: pastel over charcoal on beige laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Evelyn Stefansson Nef and Mr. and Mrs. James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing. She is slightly to the right, looking downward with her face in profile. The woman has a soft complexion, indistinct facial features, and her hair is tucked under a wide-brimmed hat. She is wearing a long dress with muted pastel colors and long sleeves, along with dark shoes that seem greenish. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Boy Gazing Upward in Adoration
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and The William Stamps Farish Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts the upper half of a person's body facing slightly upward and to the right. The individual has arms extended outward with open hands. The facial features are outlined, with the head tilted upward, eyes looking at the sky, and lips slightly parted. The hair is short and closely cropped. The clothing is loose and flowing, resembling a robe or cloak. No jewelry or objects are visible in the person's hands. The background is a simple blue-gray color, contrasting with the reddish-brown chalk sketch of the figure.

artworks.title: The Wedding Procession
artworks.medium: red chalk over red chalk counterproof on laid paper

artworks.title: An Elderly Man with a Flowing Beard
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of the head and partial neck of an older man in profile, facing to the left. His head is slightly tilted downward. He has prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a long, flowing beard, and thinning hair on the top of his head. The drawing focuses on detailed line work, highlighting the texture of his hair and beard. There is no clothing visible around his neck and shoulders. The background is plain, with no additional objects or scenery.

artworks.title: A Monkey Playing on His Back
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monkey. The monkey is in a relaxed pose with an expressive face. The image shows a monkey lying down with its limbs extended, one arm raised, and its tail gently curved. The sketch features loose, gestural lines that capture the dynamism of the animal’s form. The face of the monkey is detailed with a subtle expression. Pencil shading is used for light and shadow, adding depth to the drawing. The overall composition maintains a sense of movement and fluidity, suggesting the natural energy of the animal.

artworks.title: Studies of a Left Arm, a Young Woman, a Madonna and Child, a Face in Profile, and Nude Figures
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure with additional sketch elements. The image shows a detailed anatomical study, with a focus on a reclining nude figure on the lower section. Surrounding this main figure are various sketchy elements, including a standing figure on the right and a separate figure in the center with distinct facial features and postures. The composition emphasizes muscle definition and body form, with lines and shading. Text is included in the drawing. The style is fluid and expressive, with loose lines and cross-hatching for shadows and contours.

artworks.title: Studies of a Sculpture of a Male Nude, Vertebrae, and Gesturing Figures
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of fluid lines and shapes arranged in an abstract manner. A central figure resembles a muscular form with exaggerated curves, hinting at a torso and head. Surrounding this figure are additional abstract lines that can be seen as limbs or drapery. The composition includes scribbles and what could be notes or annotations. The image has a textured appearance, with familiar forms emerging from the lines, like a reclining torso or gesturing hands.

artworks.title: Les Mal Tournés
artworks.medium: photo-relief with watercolor stenciling
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a full-profile illustration of a man facing left. He has a pronounced nose, short-cropped hair, and a determined expression. The man wears a dark suit, collar, tie, and dark shoes. His hands are in his pockets, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The background features pastel colors and various text elements, including the words "Les Mal Tournés" and details about a performance in Paris with names like Mévisto, René Esse, and Léopold Gangloff.

artworks.title: Salut, Drapeau!
artworks.medium: photo-relief with watercolor stenciling
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cover design for the music sheet of "Salut, Drapeau!" by René Esse. The image features an outdoor scene with exaggerated features and vibrant colors. In the foreground, a male figure with a large bow tie and suit gazes toward another figure who is playing a horn, depicted in a seated position with a plaid shirt. In the background, a soldier stands on a winding path, which separates the color-blocked areas of pink and green, with an abstract representation of a red ship visible on the horizon. Large bold text overlays the image with the title and artist's information.

artworks.title: Théâtre Libre: La Fumée, puis la Flamme
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a theatrical poster for a play titled "La Fumée, puis la Flamme." The artwork features a stylized depiction of smoke transforming into fire, with flowing orange and black forms suggesting movement and transformation. A figure with an elongated arm and flowing hair rises from the flames, intertwining with curvilinear designs. The design includes text in French, listing the cast and details of the theater performance at Le Théâtre Libre for the 1895-1896 season. This is in the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, known for his graphic and innovative poster works for theatrical productions.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Bearded Man in Ancient Dress
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking to the right, holding an object in their right hand. They are wearing an ancient Roman or Greek-style draped garment with a head covering. The person's face is in profile, looking slightly upward. Garlands with objects like a basket and cloth hang in the air around them. The background is plain, emphasizing the person and the hanging objects.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.medium: black chalk on bluish laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a young child's head and part of the shoulders, seen from a three-quarter view. The child is positioned slightly angled to the viewer's left. The sketch displays delicate facial features, with softly rounded cheeks, small lips, and a gaze from lightly shaded eyes. The child's hair is depicted in soft, flowing curls that frame the face. The clothing appears to be simple, suggested by faint lines indicating a garment that covers the shoulders. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the subject. The sketch is on textured paper, which shows signs of age, including some stains and creases along the edges.

artworks.title: Dice-Thrower and Other Studies after Ancient Sculptures
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features several figures and heads sketched on a single sheet. There are three detailed head studies and two full figures. The heads display classical Grecian features and varying styles of hair. The largest drawing shows a seated figure draped in flowing garments, with a focus on anatomy, shading, and posture. Light pencil shading emphasizes form and the interplay of light and shade. The composition appears to be a practice piece or preparatory study exploring different angles and expressions in classical art.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Woman in Ancient Dress
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in motion, positioned slightly turned to the viewer's right. They have arms extended to either side, holding a flowing material. Their facial features are delicate with closed eyes or in shadow, and they have long hair. They wear a flowing garment that suggests a long dress or robe. The surroundings include decorative elements like garlands, festooned drapery, and a central feature resembling a classical or mythical mask with horns. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Socrates and Diotime
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in a classical setting. The drawing depicts a seated male figure with a muscular torso, draped in a cloth, sitting on a stool. Adjacent to him is a standing figure, draped in classical attire and extending an arm towards the seated figure with an object resembling a scroll or piece of cloth. The drawing is rendered in fine pencil lines on paper, capturing the contours and shapes with minimal shading.
